name: Lightfused Azeroot
tooltip:
Lightfused Azeroot
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
The hearty earthroot plant has grown stronger in recent years. Difficult to gather, but just as potent in crafting, azeroot is key to many recipes in Quel'Thalas.

This sturdy wooden herb can be found on or around trees in the Quel'Thalas region.

A strange light has begun to afflict the herbs growing within Quel'Thalas. They grow large and golden, reminiscent of the Sunwell itself, but twisted somehow. Gathering these herbs will release motes of holy energy that sear if caught, but yield additional resources.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
